terms.comment: Sōl in occāsum vergit. — The sun is going down (cf. Plin. NH 2.212, of the moon: vergente in occāsum; Suet. Oth. 7 vergente jam diē).

phrases.latin: Sōl in occāsum vergit; mox advesperāscet.
phrases.english: The sun is going down; soon it’ll be getting dark.

sources: Lewis & Short: occasus · Lewis & Short: vergo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 388.
